intro: Chile is a presidential democracy that returned to free elections in 1990.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years and cannot serve two terms in a row. Congress has a Senate and a Chamber of Deputies. José Antonio Kast won the 2025 election and took office in March 2026.

chapters.title: Easter Island
text: Easter Island (Rapa Nui) is a special territory 3,700 km offshore.
